name: Pulse Tunnel
author: Cyberdelia
help: Fly down a tunnel that moves to your music. A ring of the tunnel passes you on every beat, and enemies, gates and pickups arrive on the beats of whatever is playing. Rest your thumb on the wheel: your ship goes where your thumb is. It fires by itself, in time with the music. Press Select for a bomb that clears the tunnel. Fly through the gap in each gate. Green pickups power up your guns, orange ones give a bomb. Play some music first for the full ride; without music the tunnel runs at 120 BPM.

options.name: steering
options.title: Steering
options.help: Thumb: the ship goes to where your thumb rests on the wheel. Spin: turning the wheel turns the ship, and Prev and Next turn it too.

options.name: level
options.title: Difficulty
options.help: How many enemies the tunnel sends, and how many shields you start with.

options.name: tempo
options.title: Tempo
options.help: The rings against the tempo found: half or double it when the tunnel runs at the wrong speed for the music.

achievements.name: clean
achievements.title: Untouched
achievements.text: Fly a whole sector without a hit, from sector 2 on.

achievements.name: needle
achievements.title: Needle Threader
achievements.text: Fly through 16 gates in one run.
